incidents.title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
incidents.probable_root_cause: Database connection pool was saturated, leading to cascading request timeouts and worker crashes.
incidents.explanation: Observed 9 errors and 3 critical failures during window 2026-11-18 10:03:00 to 10:04:00. Applications failed to checkout database connections.
recommended_actions: Increase max_connections in the database configuration.
Audit connection pool leakages in application repositories.
Deploy PgBouncer or connection pooling proxy.
Review slow-running transactions locking database connections.
incidents.detector_triggers: [Rule] Critical errors observed (3); High error count (9); High error ratio (92.3%) | [IsolationForest] Multivariate feature anomaly (score=-0.085)
